title: Diwali ki Safai
text:
Diwali ki safai me purani cheezein milti hain:
school ka report card,
ek adhoora sweater,
aur 2014 ka mobile charger
jo kisi phone me nahi lagta. 🪔

title: Diwali ki Mithai
text:
Diwali pe jo mithai ka dabba humne bheja tha,
wo 4 ghar ghoom kar
wapas hamare paas aa gaya.
Dabbe ne humse zyada travel kiya. 🍬

title: Holi ka Rang
text:
Holi pe sabse bada jhooth:
"Ye rang herbal hai, turant nikal jaayega."
Aur agle 11 din tak
hum neele hi rehte hain. 🎨

title: Holi ki Daud
text:
Holi ke din poore saal ki fitness dikh jaati hai.
Rang leke koi peeche bhaage toh
hum Olympics level sprint karte hain. 🏃

title: Rakhi ka Gift
text:
Behen: Rakhi bandh di, ab gift?
Bhai: Pehle rakhi ka rate toh bata.
Behen: Rate nahi, bhavnayein hoti hain.
Bhai: Bhavnaon ka bhi toh budget hota hai. 🎁

title: Rakhi ki Photo
text:
Rakhi bandhne me 2 minute.
Photo kheenchne me 40 minute.
Aur status lagane me 1 ghanta.
Tyohaar ab content bhi hai. 📸

title: 15 August ki Patang
text:
15 August ko chhat pe do log hote hain:
ek patang udaane wala,
aur ek jo sirf "kaat diya!" chillane aaya hai. 🪁

title: School ka Laddoo
text:
Bachpan me 15 August ka sabse bada aakarshan
na parade thi, na bhashan —
bas wo ek laddoo jo school me milta tha. 🇮🇳

title: 26 January ki Subah
text:
26 January ki subah
school jaana sabse aasaan lagta tha,
kyunki pata tha 10 baje chhutti hai.
Desh-prem me thodi chhutti-prem bhi tha. 🎖️

title: Tiranga aur Selfie
text:
Pehle log jhanda lagate the.
Ab jhanda lagakar
14 angle se selfie lete hain.
Desh-bhakti ka resolution badh gaya hai. 📱

title: Christmas Cake
text:
Christmas pe cake kaatne se pehle
20 photo hoti hain.
Cake tab tak thoda melt,
aur candle poori tarah defeated. 🎄

title: Secret Santa
text:
Secret Santa me mujhe mila:
ek pen.
Maine diya tha:
ek bluetooth speaker.
Agle saal main bhi "secret" rahunga. 🎅

title: New Year Resolution
text:
1 January: gym, diet, jaldi uthna.
7 January: "February se shuru karunga."
31 December: "Agle saal pakka."
Resolution ek subscription hai jo auto-renew hota hai. 🎆

title: New Year Wish
text:
12 baje ke baad
300 forwarded messages aate hain.
Sabka matlab ek:
"Main zinda hoon, aap bhi rahiye." 🎉

title: Eid ki Sewaiyan
text:
Eid pe teen ghar gaya.
Teeno me sewaiyan khayi.
Chauthe ghar wale ne poocha:
"Thodi si aur?"
Maine kaha: "Bas, dil bhara hai… pet bhi." 🌙

title: Eidi ka Hisaab
text:
Bachpan me Eidi milti thi.
Bade hue toh Eidi deni padti hai.
Is transition ka koi warning message nahi aata. 💵

title: Makar Sankranti
text:
Patang udane ka rule:
jo sabse zyada shor machaye,
usne sabse kam patang udayi hoti hai. 🪁

title: Til-Gud ka Rule
text:
"Til-gud khao, meetha bolo."
Maine 3 laddu khaye
aur phir bhi bill dekh kar
meetha nahi bol paya. 🌻

title: Garba ka Step
text:
Garba me do tarah ke log hote hain:
jo steps jaante hain,
aur jo unke peeche khade hokar
unke steps copy karte hain.
Main hamesha doosri category. 💃

title: Upvas ka Menu
text:
Upvas me:
sabudana khichdi,
aloo ki sabzi,
falahari namkeen,
fruit chaat,
aur ek line: "Aaj toh kuch khaya hi nahi." 🥔

title: Pandal Hopping
text:
Pandal hopping ka plan:
8 pandal.
Reality:
2 pandal, 1 ghanta line,
aur 3 plate street food. 🎪

title: Puja ki Photo
text:
Naye kapde pehne.
60 photo kheenchi.
Ek bhi acchi nahi aayi.
Photographer dost tha, isliye kuch bol bhi nahi sakte. 📷

title: Chhath ka Anushasan
text:
Chhath ke ghat pe
safai, anushasan aur samay ka jo paalan hota hai,
wo saal bhar rahe toh
desh ka naksha badal jaaye. 🌅

title: Thekua ka Hisaab
text:
Thekua ka dabba khulte hi
ghar ke saare log "bas ek" lete hain.
"Bas ek" ka matlab yahan
kam se kam teen hota hai. 🍘

title: Valentine's Day
text:
14 February ko single logon ka
sabse bada sahara:
chocolate ka discount
jo 15 February ko aata hai. 🍫

title: Valentine ka Gift
text:
Usne kaha: "Kuch mat lena, bas time dena."
Maine sirf time diya.
Ab wo time bhi nahi de rahi. ⌛

title: Friendship Band
text:
School me friendship band ki ginti
social status thi.
Jiske haath pe 9 band the,
wo class ka celebrity tha. 🎗️

title: Friendship Day Message
text:
Friendship Day pe dost ne message bheja:
"Tu mera sabse acha dost hai."
Maine dekha — forwarded tha,
aur 12 logon ko gaya tha. 😂

title: Mother's Day
text:
Mother's Day pe maine mummy ko card diya.
Mummy: "Ye sab rehne de, kamre ki safai kar de."
Pyaar ka izhaar yahan jhaadu se hota hai. 🧹

title: Maa ka Khana
text:
Duniya ke saare restaurant mila lo,
phir bhi "maa ke haath ki daal"
kisi menu me nahi milti. ❤️

title: Father's Day
text:
Papa ko Father's Day wish kiya.
Papa: "Theek hai."
Shaam ko pata chala
unhone poore mohalle ko bata diya. 👨

title: Papa ka Gift
text:
Papa ko gift dena duniya ka sabse mushkil kaam hai.
Poochho toh: "Kuch nahi chahiye."
Do toh: "Itna paisa kyun kharch kiya?"
Na dena option hai hi nahi. 🎁
